read-only.label: Read only
read-only.description: Inspect and answer. Safe reads run; nothing changes without your approval.

ask.label: Ask for approval
ask.description: Reads run freely. Edits and commands wait for your approval.

auto.label: Approve for me
auto.description: Works inside the workspace without asking. Asks only to leave it.

full.label: Full access
full.description: Never asks. Full disk and network access.

opencode.inherit: Follow the repo trust defaults for OpenCode.
opencode.read-only: Block OpenCode tools. The agent can still answer without tools.
opencode.ask: Ask before OpenCode runs a tool.
opencode.auto: Allow OpenCode tools without approval. Panes does not add a filesystem or network sandbox.
opencode.full: Allow OpenCode tools without approval. Panes does not add a filesystem or network sandbox.

claude.inherit: Follow the repo trust defaults for Claude.
claude.read-only: Use restricted approvals with read-only files and no network.
claude.ask: Use standard approvals with workspace writes and no network.
claude.auto: Use trusted approvals and workspace writes. Network follows repo trust.
claude.full: Use trusted approvals with full disk and network access.

codexExternal.read-only: Use untrusted approvals and block network. The external sandbox controls filesystem access.
codexExternal.ask: Use on-request approvals and block network. The external sandbox controls filesystem access.
codexExternal.auto: Use on-failure approvals with network enabled. The external sandbox controls filesystem access.
